Title: Large Language Model Influence on Diagnostic Reasoning: A Randomized Clinical Trial
Study setting: Written case assessment; not real outpatient care
Participants and sample units: 50 physicians; 6 written case vignettes; not 50 patients
Intervention and comparator: Physicians using GPT-4 plus conventional resources vs conventional resources alone
Outcome measures: Diagnostic reasoning score (%); not a patient outcome
Main results: Median group scores 76% vs 74%; adjusted difference 2 percentage points (95% CI -4 to 8 percentage points); P=.60. The result establishes neither collaborative superiority nor equivalence.
Source location: Results / Primary Outcome: Diagnostic Performance; Table 2
Limitations: Small sample and written tasks; no inference of established benefit for real patients
Verification status: Course-written worked example; user must check the original independently
